summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting in the rich repo, without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] union member; rich/control.py adds the sequence formatter ESC ]0;title BEL and Control.title(title) with docstring; rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor, returning True only when is_terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md has an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200 (URL inferred from the spec, worth confirming); tests added in test_console.py (non-Windows), test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only, set_title called with "Hello, world!"). Nothing was run, so Black formatting and test results are unverified.
